title: Metrics Composer: per-model & per-route snapshot canvas for latency / tokens / throughput
creator: Grace Liu
description: Design a compact, composable 'Metrics Composer' canvas inside Redwood Console that surfaces a per-model and per-route snapshot view combining latency distributions, throughput trends, and token-level metrics. The goal is a single-canvas summary for on-call and product owners to evaluate performance regressions, rollout impacts, and cost signals without jumping between pages.
acceptance_criteria: Canvas exists as a composable page that can be embedded in model and route pages
Latency distribution histogram with percentile overlays (p50/p95/p99) and sequence-length conditioning is present
Throughput trend (TPS) sparkline with configurable aggregation window (1m/5m/15m)
Token flow view shows request token vs. response token histograms and a per-call cost overlay
Rollout annotation lane that accepts flags from the Rollouts system and highlights time ranges
Time-range brush lets user select a period which updates all charts synchronously
Export CSV / snapshot export of aggregated metrics for selected time-range
Prototype vetted by infra and API owners; implementation constraints documented
decisions: Use histogram + percentile-lines as primary latency visualization rather than only timeseries to make distribution shifts obvious
Expose sequence-length conditioning (bucket by request token length) to reveal tail-latency caused by long inputs
Overlay a semi-transparent cost-per-token line on throughput charts instead of a dedicated chart to save vertical space
Rollout events will be pulled from Rollouts API; visual lane shows canary windows and automatic fallback markers
chart_specs: Latency distribution (primary): horizontal histogram, log-scaled x-axis (ms), bins: auto with min 20 bins, stacked by model version when multi-version selected, percentile overlays: p50/p95/p99 as dashed lines with tooltips

Sequence-length bands: toggled overlay on latency histogram that splits requests into three bands (<=128, 129-1024, >1024 tokens). Each band rendered as translucent color with separate percentile markers
Throughput trend (secondary): area chart with TPS on y-axis, time on x-axis. Aggregation windows: 1m/5m/15m selectable. Include 95% bootstrap CI ribbon when sample size < 50
Token usage waterfall: stacked bar per-minute showing input tokens vs output tokens vs cached-token-savings. Bars colored: input (#6C8EFF), output (#00C49F), cache savings (#FFC658)

Cost overlay: thin line chart on secondary y-axis aligned with throughput, showing estimated $/minute using model-specific per-token cost. Hover shows breakdown by token type (prompt/response) and estimated GPU cost
Percentile trend sparkline panel: small multiples for p50/p95/p99 across selected models/routes with delta indicators relative to baseline period
Top-callers heatmap: matrix with callers on y-axis and time buckets on x-axis; color = call volume; click a row to filter entire canvas
Anomaly markers: automatic outlier detection places red flags on charts. Rules: >= 3x median p95 and sustained for 3 buckets
Rollout annotation lane: thin band on top of canvas with labeled ranges (canary start/end) and icons for manual interventions. Clicking annotation opens Rollouts detail panel
interaction_patterns: Synchronous brush: user selects time-range on any chart; all charts re-aggregate to that range
Cross-filter by model/version/route: toggles in the top toolbar; multi-select allowed
Drill to raw logs: clicking a histogram bin opens a modal with sample request IDs and link to request-level traces
Compare mode: allow pinning a baseline period (previous deploy) to overlay percent-change lines
Keyboard shortcuts: 't' toggles token overlay, 's' saves snapshot, 'e' exports CSV
components: HistogramWithPercentiles(v2): reusable component for log-scaled latency histograms
StackedTokenBar: shows input/output/cache per time bucket
AnnotationLane: generic rollout/incident lane for timeline events
HeatmapMatrix: for top-callers and sequence-length density
